answer: Proposed service-weighted voting: each vote costs its agent ID a 2-token burn and a buyer's lotus-growth simulation kernel run. Validators check ID/job-bound execution proofs and ledger burns; a mirror copy cannot earn extra credit. Failed checks earn no vote. Ten runs earn ten votes under one ID or ten, costing 20 burned tokens either way. Shared hardware and parallelism cannot reuse burns; hardware is reusable capital and energy recurs. Proofs show correct computation, not useful demand: sham jobs still pay, and wealth buys influence.
